messages:
Maria (CS): Papertrail final capacity activation scheduled Fri 2026-04-02 21:00 UTC. Need final quota sign-off, autoscale policy confirmation, and a short load test plan. Who can pair?
AJ (Ops): I can take ops lead. Quick check: customer requested 4 reserved p100 nodes + burst to 8. Do we have quota bite for that region?
Oliver (SE): Confirmed customer pool pinned to model v2.3, batch sizing target 32 for their prompt mix. I'll validate warm cache script.
Nina (SRE): Region quota is fine, but we need to pre-warm KV cache to avoid first-10-min tail latency. Suggest 30m warmup with synthetic traces.
Devon (AM): I'll be on the call for the renewal touchpoint — want to ensure activation goes smooth. If we show stable 99.9% p95 after activation we can reduce renewal risk.
AJ (Ops): Plan I propose: 1) Reserve nodes + deploy model variant 2) 30m warmup (prefix-heavy traces) 3) ramp to 75% traffic for 20m 4) run 15m soak at target QPS 5) cut-over. Load test script:
AJ (Ops): ```
./lt --target papertrail --rps 650 --concurrency 120 --duration 35m --seed-traces ./papertrail-traces.json
```
Maria (CS): @Devon can you confirm the success criteria we communicate to customer? Also want written sign-off on quota so billing not delayed.
Devon (AM): Success criteria: p95 latency < 220ms, error rate < 0.1%, token cost within 8% of projected estimate. I'll send a one-pager and capture verbal sign-off after run.
Oliver (SE): Minor note: for this workload the runtime recommends enabling partial-kv-caching and dynamic-batching pref of 32/64. I'll push a config patch to the staging pool and share diff:
Oliver (SE): ```
batching: { target_batch: 32, max_batch_delay_ms: 6 }
caching: { kv_prefetch: true, prefix_cache: enabled }
```
Nina (SRE): Autoscale policy check: scale-up threshold 70% GPU util sustained 60s, scale-down after 300s below 40%. With warm cache we should avoid noisy autoscale during ramp. I'll watch metrics and pre-create alert runbook.
AJ (Ops): I'll run a dry-run tomorrow at 18:00 UTC with synthetic traces to verify policy. If dry-run passes, proceed Fri live. Dry-run plan posted in ops-runbook channel.
Oncall Bot: Pool "papertrail-reserved" -> resized to 6 nodes (reserved 4 + 2 buffer) at 2026-04-01T18:05:12Z
Maria (CS): Capture feedback: after soak, we'll send feedback form (2 quick q's) and a short checklist: "how was handover, latency satisfaction, any unexpected errors". I will attach to the post-run customer note.
Devon (AM): I'll ask the customer to join the last 10m of the soak so they can see metrics live. Also will request their in-product usage forecasts for next quarter to adjust billing/commit.
Oliver (SE): One gotcha: model quantization fallback triggers for long sequences. I'll include a test case in the load script to exercise 2k token stories.
Nina (SRE): Acknowledged. I'll add an incident stub for the window and a pager for >0.5% 5m error spike.
Maria (CS): Great. Owners: AJ = ops lead, Oliver = SE config, Nina = SRE monitoring, Devon = account/renewal. I'll send invite for Fri 20:30 UTC runbook walk. Any blockers?
AJ (Ops): None from infra, will confirm dry-run results tomorrow.
Devon (AM): All good. Will prep renewal note.
Oliver (SE): Sharing patch in 10m.
Nina (SRE): I'll create alert links and dashboard snapshots for the customer view.
Maria (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will post summary and customer-facing schedule after the dry-run.
